sessions.directivePrompt:
Read-only exploration. Investigate current Discord channel management tools in this repository.
Goals:
1) Find all existing tools for channel create/edit/move/rename/category operations.
2) Identify where tools are declared/exported and how schemas are defined.
3) Confirm whether update/edit existing channel topic/description exists today.
Return:
- concise summary
- exact file paths + line references
- suggested insertion points for new update-channel tools per channel type (text/voice/forum)
Do not modify files.

Read-only exploration. Inventory markdown/docs structure in repo.
Goals:
1) List all .md files and current folders.
2) Distinguish product docs vs meta/process docs vs README/CONTRIBUTING.
3) Propose migration plan to move relevant docs into docs/ with minimal breakage.
4) Note references/links that will need path updates.
Return:
- proposed target docs tree
- file move map old->new
- risky links to update
Do not modify files.

Read-only exploration. Inspect test coverage around Discord tools for channels.
Goals:
1) Find tests related to create channel, category rename/move, moderation tools architecture.
2) Identify test patterns/conventions for adding new tools.
3) Recommend test cases for new CRUD/update channel tools per channel type.
Return:
- test file paths + line refs
- concrete test checklist for new tool implementations
Do not modify files.

Read-only exploration. Determine what Discord gateway/client abstraction already supports for creating/updating channel types.
Investigate:
1) Where gateway methods for create/edit channel live.
2) Existing methods for text/voice/forum create/update/delete.
3) Whether wrappers already exist for editing channel fields (topic, nsfw, bitrate, forum tags/guidelines, category/position, slowmode, etc).
4) Any permission or type validation patterns.
Return exact file paths + line ranges and a recommended minimal API/tool design compatible with current code.

Review the implementation plan for feature `add-channel-update-tool-and-docs-reorg` at `.hive/features/01_add-channel-update-tool-and-docs-reorg/plan.md`.

Evaluate:
1) Requirement coverage vs user request (per-type CRUD/update for text/voice/forum + docs reorg into docs/)
2) Task ordering/dependencies realism
3) Risky assumptions (discord.py field support, forum guideline fields, migration link risks)
4) Missing validation/testing scope
5) Scope creep / YAGNI issues

Return:
- Verdict: OKAY or REJECT
- Critical issues (if any)
- Suggested concrete edits to the plan (with section references)
- Optional execution cautions for workers

Review the latest merged implementation batch for feature `add-channel-update-tool-and-docs-reorg`.
Please inspect current branch changes around:
- New/updated channel admin tools (text/voice/forum create+update)
- Schema/router wiring
- Tests for channel admin tools
- Docs updates and markdown reorganization into docs/

Return:
1) Verdict: OKAY or REJECT
2) Critical issues (correctness, regression, API contract mismatch)
3) Minor improvements
4) Whether it is safe to finalize feature now
Include concrete file references.

Where is resolve_forum_post expected to be defined? Find the DiscordGateway and forum post tools.
    - Find uses of resolve_forum_post
    - Check if it exists in DiscordGateway
    - Look in forum post tools (like get_thread_context, read_forum_post_messages)

Explore the codebase for the "NoneType object has no attribute 'value'" error related to Enums in:
    - audit logs (get_audit_log)
    - health_check (server_health_check)
    - moderation history (get_member_moderation_history)
    - create_role
    Find where .value is accessed on potentially None Enums.

Find where automod_get_ruleset is implemented and how ruleset.rules is handled.
    - Check the schema definitions in automod models
    - Check the handler in automod.py or similar
    - Find the error source for 'ruleset.rules must be an array'

Review the bug fixes for the discord-mcp codebase.
Please review the changes made to:
- src/discord_mcp/services/discord_gateway.py (fetch_audit_entries kwargs fix, resolve_forum_post alias)
- src/discord_mcp/tools/handlers/role_governance.py (create_role and update_role kwargs fix)
- src/discord_mcp/tools/handlers/automod_policy.py (_validate_ruleset_shape handling missing 'rules')

Run git diff HEAD to see the changes. Confirm if the logic is safe, Pythonic, and aligns with the expected behavior of discord.py.
